correctness.rationale: Gauss collocation has R_s(z)=P_s(z)/P_s(-z); integral representation makes |R_s(-x)|<1 and even-stage R_s(-x)>0. Walsh diagonalization gives Krawtchouk kernel coefficients. Odd s→-1 on positive modes, giving negative diagonal for d>=2 at large h. Even s has R_s(-x)=1-2s(s+1)/x+O(x^-2); for d>=3 the nearest-neighbor coefficient is -s(s+1)S_d/(2^d h)+O(h^-2) with S_3=1/6 and S_(d+1)>S_d. Symbolic independent exact checks verified all 4 Q3 rational numerators against common denominator, unique positive quartic root 8.583763463733359, and positive S_d for d=3..9. For s=2, Q1,Q2 all h remain nonnegative; analytic coefficient signs establish Q3 iff cutoff. No extrapolation from bounded tests.
